evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Known Nb3Ga and mixed A15 B-site superconductors establish the family prior, not this fully ordered Pm-3 Nb6GaRh state. Dated 2026-10-07 exact Nb6GaRh/Nb6GaSb/Nb6PdPt queries found no exact experimental superconducting match. Novelty is the single Ga-for-Al ordered-source construction hypothesis, not discovery of superconductivity in Nb-rich alloys.

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The exact target has no signed negative sampled-path values or negative optical compression. Order/disorder, competing A15 compositions and a martensitic/CDW branch remain the relevant risks; the fine force 0.033558 eV/A and early eigen warnings are preserved. GaNb6Sb is better at all sigma values and remains a retained opposite control. The small minimum effect and changed ecutwfc require a common-cutoff falsifier, rather than an asserted numerical significance bound.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.033558041 eV/A, P=0.062 GPa, full max stress=0.062 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

counterevidence.scope: This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Ga replaces Al at the unique Al/Ga site while all six Nb-chain and Rh roles remain mapped. Cell volume contracts 0.5193% and nearest Nb-Nb falls 0.0158926 A. The coupled ordered-site/chain construction gives a modest but same-sign 3.796–18.373% lambda improvement and separate Eli mu=.1 13.213 to 14.014 K. It is not proof of pure compression or higher mobile carrier density.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare the retained Ga/Al site roles at common cutoff/PP family and volume, quantify Nb-chain response and test order/CDW stability. A stable persistent gain supports this narrow hypothesis; disappearance within common sampling or a chain instability opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
